label: Whoever bears an occurring thought episode opines that episode's…, by Universal instantiation and…
meaning: Every occurring thought episode is assenting (OPEN), and the bearer of an assenting episode opines its content (OPEN); hence whoever bears an occurring thought opines its content. A chain through the distinct middle term Assenting (#1214). The first premise is the load-bearing and contested one: a borne willing or doubt without assent falsifies it (NonAssentingThought).
